events.name: Back To The Future Part II Featuring Live Q&A
events.info: One of the biggest movie hits of 1989, Back to the Future Part II, the long awaited sequel to the 1985 smash hit, brought Marty McFly and Doc Brown roaring back to the big screen for an even bigger journey through time. This time, Marty and Doc travel to the futuristic world of 2015, only to discover that changing the future has disastrous consequences for the past. Their adventure sends them racing between 2015, an alternate 1985, and back to 1955 in an ingenious continuation of the original classic. This special big screen presentation comes with a very special guest! Jeffrey Weissman, who portrayed George McFly in Back to the Future Part II and Back to the Future Part III, will be joining us IN PERSON! Experience this beloved time-travel blockbuster on the big screen and meet one of the actors who helped bring the legendary McFly family to life. Jeffrey will be meeting fans when doors open and will also be available for autographs and photo ops before the film.
events.pleaseNote: Performing at the historic Crest Theater located in downtown Sacramento (1013 K Street). No outside food, drink, or weapons allowed inside the theater (including pepper spray and concealed weapons permitted firearms). All guests subject to wand screening and bag search. All sales final. Only purchase new and resale tickets through Ticketmaster to assure authenticity. Convenient parking available at municipal garages located at 1000 10th Street and 915 I Street.
